spec.description: Puck dedicated server metrics — game state, player counts, performance, and autoscaling signals

spec.title: Mod Script Time (main-thread share)
spec.description: Seconds of main-thread time per second spent in each mod's Update/FixedUpdate/LateUpdate hooks (0.01 = 1% of a core). Harmony-timed; work a mod does inside patches on game methods lands in the engine stages instead.

spec.title: Mod Worst Invocation
spec.description: Slowest single script-hook invocation in the last collection interval. The main-thread frame budget at tickRate 360 is 2.8ms.

spec.title: Engine Stage Time (main-thread share)
spec.description: Player-loop stage cost, stacked: EarlyUpdate ≈ transport drain, FixedUpdate ≈ physics + replication, Update ≈ scripts (the gap between this and the mod panels is MaxPractice + engine script residual).

spec.title: Stage Worst Pass
spec.description: Slowest single pass of each player-loop stage in the last collection interval.

spec.title: Stall Frames (>50ms)
spec.description: Frames per second that took longer than 50ms — hitches players feel. Sustained non-zero here is the degradation signal.

spec.title: Sync States vs Connected Clients
spec.description: Leak detector: the replication manager should hold exactly one synchronized player state per connected client. Sync states climbing above connected clients = orphaned per-client send states, each costing a full planning pass every tick at 100Hz.

spec.title: Network Objects & Pucks
spec.description: Spawned NetworkObjects and live pucks. A slow climb across days means something spawns without despawning.

spec.title: Scene Transforms
spec.description: Whole-scene transform census, sampled every 5 minutes by default (SceneCountIntervalSeconds, 0 = off; each sweep costs one long frame). The watchdog for mods whose internals we cannot see (MaxPractice): a steady climb is an object leak.

spec.title: Puck.log Size
spec.description: The game's own log file. tlan-admin rotates it at 64MB, so a healthy server shows a sawtooth; unbounded growth means rotation is off or broken.

spec.title: Process Working Set
spec.description: Resident memory of the server process. The practice container limit is 1792Mi; cgroup reclaim pressure (the lag phase) begins well before the limit.

spec.title: Process Handles
spec.description: OS handle count (where the runtime reports it). A steady multi-day climb is a native handle leak — sockets, wait handles, files.

spec.title: Steps/s vs tick rate
spec.description: Fixed steps achieved per second. Should sit on tick_rate × time_scale; lower means Unity's maximumDeltaTime clamp is discarding simulation time.

spec.title: Step interval avg / p99 / max
spec.description: Wall-clock gap between consecutive fixed steps (slow-motion excluded). Nominal 10 ms; 20 ms = one missed step, 50 ms = a visible hitch.

spec.title: Late steps / min
spec.description: Steps whose gap from the previous step exceeded 2× or 5× the tick interval.

spec.title: Bunched frames & catch-up steps / min
spec.description: Frames that ran 2+ fixed steps (so 2+ state sends left in one frame) and the extra steps they carried. This is the stutter clients feel.

spec.title: Max steps in one frame
spec.description: 1 = healthy. Unity caps near maximumDeltaTime / fixedDeltaTime (~33).

spec.title: Worst single step: physics span vs replication send vs FixedUpdate stage
spec.description: physics span = OnBeforeSimulate→OnAfterSimulate (PhysX + FixedUpdate scripts + collision callbacks + earlier subscribers). Server_Tick = the state send. The stage is the whole FixedUpdate player-loop pass.

spec.title: Main-thread share
spec.description: Seconds per second spent in each part. Residual between stage and (span + Server_Tick) is engine FixedUpdate scripts outside the span.

spec.title: Simulate subscribers by mod (needs EnableModTiming)
spec.description: Main-thread share of mods hooked on PhysicsManager.OnBeforeSimulate / OnAfterSimulate (e.g. tlan-replay's sampler).

spec.title: Main thread: CPU vs run-queue wait
spec.description: From /proc/self/schedstat. Run-queue wait = the game thread was runnable but not on a CPU. Rising with bunched frames = contention/steal on the node; bunching without wait = our own frame cost.

spec.title: Main thread: involuntary context switches / s
spec.description: Preemptions of the game thread.

spec.title: Process CPU (user / system)
spec.description: Whole server process, all threads, from /proc/self/stat.

spec.title: Container CPU (cAdvisor)
spec.description: The puck container as the kubelet sees it (vmagent kubelet-cadvisor job).

spec.title: Node: run-queue wait & CPU busy (node of the selected pod)
spec.description: node_schedstat_waiting = time runnable tasks waited per CPU, summed over the node's CPUs. CPU busy averaged over the node's CPUs.

spec.expr: (1 - avg by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[1m]))) and on(node) count by (node) (puck_server_uptime_seconds{pod=~"$pod"})

spec.title: Player ping min / avg / max
spec.description: UTP round-trip per player; spread widening on every pod at once points at the host or its uplink.

spec.title: Packets / s
spec.description: Inbound scales with players × client input rate (serverConfig.tickRate).

spec.title: Longest receive stall
spec.description: Longest span in a 2 s interval with no packet received at all. With a lobby sending input, >100 ms means the socket was not drained.

spec.title: UDP socket errors / s
spec.description: RcvbufErrors = kernel dropped datagrams because the socket buffer was full (receiver too slow). InErrors includes them.

spec.title: softnet drops & time squeeze / s
spec.description: Packets dropped in the NIC backlog and softirq budget exhaustion.

spec.title: Physics Cadence (B1235: 100 Hz fixed step drives the state send)
CPU Evidence (is the host starving the game thread?)
Node Network Health (node of the selected pod)
